channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: “Our safe streets are here to stay”: Mayor’s “dangerous” decision to axe low traffic neighbourhoods deemed unlawful, as campaigners hail “huge precedent for London”
item.description: The Court of Appeal ruled the removal of three liveable streets in Tower Hamlets by its mayor Lutfur Rahman failed to implement Sadiq Khan’s transport strategy for London, after years of legal wrangling

item.title: Banned driver avoids jail after hitting 10-year-old cyclist while overtaking bus on wrong side of road in series of “spectacularly stupid, immature, and reckless decisions”
item.description: The motorist, who was banned from driving following a speeding offence at the time of the collision, was handed another 12-month suspension and ordered to pay £2,000 in compensation

item.title: New Jersey blanket e-bike law will remove “a viable alternative to cars from the road”
item.description: All e-bikers in the US state will require a licence, registration and insurance from this summer. What could go wrong?

item.title: “Politicians can’t simply ‘rip out’ LTNs and bike lanes they don’t like”; Cycle lane plans scrapped at last minute; Matthews life-threatening diagnosis + more on the live blog
item.description: Megan’s back to carry you through to the weekend with all the latest news from across the world of cycling

item.title: Topeak E-Booster Digital Mini
item.description: Decent electric mini inflator that is a doddle to use but the battery capacity is not as large as the competition 7/10

item.title: “Extreme weather. Santos. The irony”: Fire danger warning and soaring temperatures see Tour Down Under stage shortened and Willunga Hill removed – days after riders urged race to ditch “embarrassing” oil and gas title sponsor
item.description: “Rider and spectator safety is always the number one priority for our event,” Tour Down Under race director Stuart O’Grady said following the decision to modify Saturday’s stage, with temperatures of 43°C forecast

item.title: “Transformational” cycling schemes saved NHS over £13 million, new research reveals – as governing bodies call for £30m “targeted public investment” to leave lasting Tour de France legacy and turn Britain into “true nation of cyclists”
item.description: According to the data, the Places to Ride programme has delivered over £100m in health and social value since it was launched in 2019

item.title: Cyclists should “take own responsibility” for safety says Reform councillor, as Halfords and police join forces for bike lights campaign to “make roads safer”

item.description: Won the lottery? Fancy blinging up your cockpit?

item.title: Disabled cyclists “abused by vigilante residents” for riding in town centre – as changes made to controversial cycling trial to “prioritise” bikes as mobility aids
item.description: The modifications to the Experimental Traffic Regulation Order mean that disabled people will be able to cycle on the town centre street during market hours
